title: Your elevator. Your specification.
description: Plan the dimensions, explore the finishes, and send your configuration to BG Elevators.
successMessage: Your configuration has been saved. Our team will contact you to review the project.
measurementHelp: Pit depth is measured from the lowest landing floor to the bottom of the shaft. Headroom is measured from the highest landing floor to the shaft ceiling.
reviewNote: A configuration is a project brief. Final dimensions, compliance and suitability require review by our engineering team.
